Kling AI   /   Head of Keye

Bin Wen

I lead Keye at Kling AI, where I oversee pre-training, mid-training, and post-training for multimodal foundation models.

My research spans model architecture, training data, and alignment. I also work on video agent harnesses and generative recommendation.
